name: Akane House
description: Akane House is a block theme for a neighbourhood gastropub that keeps one room open from the lunchtime pie to last orders. The home page follows the sittings of a single day at 3 Tanner's Row, Eastbridge, the lodge Ruth Okafor and Tomas Brandt reopened in 2014. Pages cover the menu, the bar, the private room, a visit, and one way to book a table. Dark low-key photography on a quiet plum-grey paper (#DDD9DC), slash-numbered chapters with the text at 50%, ragged four-up photo tiles with captions above, a letterbox parallax band and a near-black reservation band. Cormorant Garamond for headings, Libre Baskerville for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
